subject: Religious education (RE)

source.title: National curriculum in England: framework for key stages 1 to 4

note: This dataset records the statutory requirement to teach religious education at every key stage. RE is not one of the 12 national-curriculum subjects with a single national programme of study; syllabus content is determined through the applicable legal and school context. TEACHR therefore does not invent national subject objectives for RE.

KS1.summary: Religious education must be taught to pupils at key stage 1; TEACHR does not assign a national programme-of-study objective where the source does not provide one.

KS2.summary: Religious education must be taught to pupils at key stage 2; TEACHR does not assign a national programme-of-study objective where the source does not provide one.
